people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus rebuked him, the demon went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment.
translations.kjv: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
translations.asv: And Jesus rebuked him; and the demon went out of him: and the boy was cured from that hour.
